name: CymbalAutoCommerceAgentTools
description: Tool definitions for Google ADK and Vertex AI Long Horizon Agents interacting with Cymbal Auto UCP platform.

tools.name: getStockLevels
tools.description: Retrieves the current stock state and inventory count for a given product across all depots or a specific store.

productId.description: Unique identifier of the tyre product (e.g. 'michelin-ps5-225-45r17')

storeId.description: Optional store ID to filter by (e.g. 'birmingham', 'bristol', 'croydon')

tools.name: replenishStock
tools.description: Simulates or executes an inventory arrival/replenishment at an autocentre depot.

quantity.description: Number of tyre units to add to inventory

tools.name: getPendingPurchaseIntents
tools.description: Retrieves authorized AP2 conditional purchase intents awaiting back-in-stock fulfillment.

tools.name: fulfillPurchaseIntent
tools.description: Autonomously executes an order against an authorized AP2 conditional purchase intent once inventory requirements and price caps are met.

intentId.description: The unique ID of the purchase intent record

fulfillmentNote.description: Reason or agent log for fulfillment execution

tools.name: applyCheckoutRecovery
tools.description: Applies a targeted recovery incentive discount and customer guidance message to a stalled checkout session.

discountPercent.description: Percentage discount to grant (maximum allowed is 15%)

recoveryMessage.description: Personalized message explaining the recovery offer

tools.name: getCheckoutSession
tools.description: Fetches the full session state, item contents, and customer details of a UCP checkout.

checkoutId.description: The unique ID of the checkout session

tools.name: escalateSurveyDetractor
tools.description: Logs an escalation ticket for store management when a customer submits an NPS rating of 6 or below.

orderId.description: Order ID associated with the survey

suggestedResolution.description: Agent-proposed remedy (e.g. Free re-balance, manager call)
